content.text:
The products page is fixed. The "Add to cart" buttons had invisible text.

In `site/css/components.css`, `.btn-secondary` set its text colour to `var(--color-surface)`, which is also its background colour. I changed the text colour to `var(--color-ink)`.

`.btn-secondary` is a shared style, so the same bug was hiding button text on the home, pricing and orders pages. That explains why the visual tests flagged those pages too. All 12 visual snapshots now match the approved baselines, so I didn't approve or change any baselines. The 16 functional tests pass.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see what the "last change" was. I found the cause by running the visual tests and reading the style differences they reported.

STATUS: DONE
